entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Pradeep Chauhan, the learned counsel for applicants and the learned A.G.A. for State.

3. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by accused-applicants Rafe and Umer with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and quash the impugned Charge Sheet dated Rafe And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162291310/
1 23.07.2023 in Case No.4549 of 2023 (State Vs. Rafe and Another) arising out of Case Crime No.450 of 2023, under Sections 366, 376(d), 342, 323, 504 I.P.C., Police Station- Jiyanpur, District- Azamgarh as well as Cognizance order dated 27.07.2023,
pending before the court of Judicial Magistrate, Court No.24, Azamgarh; otherwise the applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury.

It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may also be pleased to stay the further proceedings of Case No.4549 of 2023 (State Vs. Rafe and Another) arising out of Case Crime No.450 of 2023, under Sections 366, 376(d), 342, 323, 504 I.P.C., Police Station- Jiyanpur, District- Azamgarh, pending before the court of Judicial Magistrate, Court No.24, Azamgarh and further not to take any coercive action against the applicants in the aforesaid case, during the pendency of the instant application before this Hon'ble Court; otherwise applicants shall suffer irreparable loss and injury.

entities.text: Case No.4549 of 2023 (State Vs. Rafe and Another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
And/or pass such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
4. After some arguments, it transpires that in view of the compromise entered into by the parties,
PW-1 first informant has not supported the FIR.

However, there is nothing on record to show that the parties have entered into a compromise and consequently, the compromise application was filed before Court below seeking termination of the impugned proceedings on the ground of compromise.
5.

At this juncture, the learned counsel for applicants fairly submits that he be permitted to withdraw the present application with liberty to file a fresh application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
after the parties have filed a comprehensive compromise before Court below.
6. Prayer made by the learned counsel for applicants is bona-fide.

Same is not opposed by the learned A.G.A.
7.
8. In view of above, the present application is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.
9. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

Order Date :- 10.1.2025 Vinay  Rafe And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162291310/
